response_snapshot.summary: Thread-safety issue detected on shared mutable singleton field.

findings.title: Race Condition on Shared Mutable State in Singleton Service
findings.description: The primitive integer 'visitCount' is not thread-safe. Concurrent requests will cause lost updates during '++visitCount'.
findings.recommendation: Replace 'int' with java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger and use incrementAndGet().

refactoring_suggestions.title: Use AtomicInteger for Thread-Safe Counter
refactoring_suggestions.rationale: Ensures atomic lock-free increments under concurrent multi-threaded execution.
refactoring_suggestions.before_snippet:
private int visitCount = 0;
public int increment() { return ++visitCount; }
refactoring_suggestions.after_snippet:
private final AtomicInteger visitCount = new AtomicInteger(0);
public int increment() { return visitCount.incrementAndGet(); }
